title: Dual-effect pre-potassiation unlocks stable and high-energy potassium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2703-2714
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06846K, Paper
Nan Li, Yixiang He, Jiacheng Zhu, Xiaofang Wang, Yifan Chen, Yusi Yang, Linlin Wang, Xiaogang Niu, Xiao Ji, Xuefeng Wang, Qianfan Zhang, Yujie Zhu
An overdischarge strategy is proposed to enable the in situ formation of KxMn[Fe(CN)6] (x > 2) and the generation of a robust SEI, significantly improving the cyclability and energy density of K2Mn[Fe(CN)6]–graphite potassium-ion batteries.
